# DEPRECATED — ba-workboard standalone package

**Version 10:** the standalone `ba-workboard` sub-skill and this dist package are **obsolete**.

Use instead:

- Inline procedure: `skills/ba-assistant/references/workboard-procedure.md`
- Format: `skills/ba-assistant/references/workboard-format.md`
- Personal tasks: `skills/ba-assistant/references/ba-actions-format.md`

Do not install files from this `dist/ba-workboard-package/` folder on new machines.
